description: The plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates how Pass@8 accuracy varies with the temperature setting for three methods. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 62.5 to 80.0 with tick marks every 2.5 units. Three lines are shown: the On-policy RL series is an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting near 63.5 at temperature 0.1, rising to about 70.0 at 0.2, fluctuating around the high 60s to low 70s through 0.6 (about 71.8 at 0.6), dipping to about 67.5 at 0.7, then increasing to about 75.0 at 0.8, dropping to about 71.0 at 0.9, and ending near 73.5 at 1.0. The LUFFY series is a red solid line with star markers, starting around 76.0 at 0.1, increasing to about 78.8 at 0.2, staying around 76–77 from 0.3 to 0.6 (about 77.0 at 0.6), then rising to about 79.8 at 0.7 and about 80.5 at 0.8, decreasing to about 79.0 at 0.9, and ending near 80.7 at 1.0. The SFT series is a teal solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers, starting around 76.0 at 0.1, decreasing to about 75.2 at 0.2 and about 74.5 at 0.3–0.4, dropping to about 70.0 at 0.5, rising back to about 76.0 at 0.6, decreasing to about 72.0 at 0.7, increasing to about 73.5 at 0.8, decreasing to about 71.0 at 0.9, and ending near 74.5 at 1.0.
